title: Sweetwater Grade 2 lesson plan, week of Nov 9
scope: Excerpts only: lesson-content lines ClassThread items cite. No names, rosters, small-group links or student information.
content:
[11.9-11.13 | Phonics, Monday (Session 1), Success Criteria] read and write words with the long i sound spelled y and igh. / read the super words also, been, look, and good.
[11.9-11.13 | Phonics, Tuesday (Session 2), Success Criteria] recognize and read contractions.
[11.9-11.13 | Phonics, Wednesday (Session 3), Success Criteria] read and write words with the long i sound spelled i and ie.
[11.9-11.13 | Reading, Vocabulary & Strategy] notice, wonder, summarize, key details, retell habitat, desert, survive, ecosystem, dunes, canyon, cactus, spines, shelter, shady, valley, burrowing
[11.9-11.13 | Writing, Monday, I do] Explain the meaning of desert, habitat, and survive.
[11.9-11.13 | Grammar, Wednesday (Session 3), Learning Target] Today I will identify adjectives in a sentence.
[11.9-11.13 | Grammar, Thursday (Session 4), Learning Target] Today I will identify sentences that use commas correctly.
[11.9-11.13 | Grammar, Standards, Friday] 2.L.V.3.c Distinguish shades of meaning among verbs that differ in manner (e.g., look, peek, glance, stare, glare, scowl) and adjectives that differ in intensity (e.g., large, gigantic).
[11.9-11.13 | Math, Lesson Title] Unit 2: Lesson 10 Solve Word Problems Involving Money
[11.9-11.13 | Math, Monday Session 1, Learning Target] count up groups of coins or bills to find out how much money there is in all.
[11.9-11.13 | SS, Lesson Title] Unit 2: Our Georgia (Georgia's Three Major Rivers)
[11.9-11.13 | SS, Standard] SS2G1.b Locate on a physical map the major rivers: Savannah, Flint, and Chattahoochee.
[11.9-11.13 | SS, Monday, We Do] Locate Georgia on a physical map and identify blue lines that represent rivers.
[11.9-11.13 | SS, Daily Plan] Monday Lesson: What is a River? / Tuesday Lesson: The Chattahoochee River / Wednesday Lesson: The Savannah River / Thursday Lesson: The Flint River / Friday Lesson: River Map Challenge
[11.9-11.13 | SS, CER Exit Ticket, Tuesday] Which river forms much of Georgia’s Western border?
[11.9-11.13 | SS, CER Exit Ticket, Wednesday] Which river forms much of Georgia’s Eastern border?
[11.9-11.13 | SS, CER Exit Ticket, Thursday] Is the Flint River located in Eastern or Western Georgia?
[11.16-11.20 | SS, Lesson Title] Unit 2: Our Georgia (Georgia’s regions and three major rivers review)
